FN-DG1ZIHT-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 546
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Frances Holk-Jones
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 546 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an undetermined amount for Fiscal Years 2026 and 2027 dependent upon the amount
of purchases for capital expenditures, made by the Zoo Foundation, Inc., operating as the
Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo, which would be exempted from the payment of state and municipal
sales and use taxes pursuant to this bill.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to county and municipal funds by an
undetermined amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 through Fiscal Year 2027, dependent on
the purchases made by the entity in each respective county and the applicable county tax rates ,
if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from county sales and use tax, pursuant
to this bill.
